sample_unit: participants (youth neuroimaging datasets: PNC n=1291, HBN n=1110, HCPD n=428)

links.outcome: Prediction performance when trained and tested across unharmonized external datasets versus within-dataset cross-validation
links.effect: Predictions generalized across three heterogeneous datasets; for HCPD and HBN the best predictions came from cross-dataset training and testing rather than within-dataset cross-validation.
links.quote: Notably, for the HCPD and HBN datasets, the best predictions were not from training and testing in the same dataset (i.e., cross-validation) but across datasets.

screen.reason: Evaluates external validation and cross-dataset generalizability of neuroimaging predictive models across unharmonized datasets, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
